policy: All roles consume shared status/evidence; do not re-probe blocked endpoints per role. Invalidate on observed network revision/access change or deliberate central diagnosis, not on permission text alone. Cap consecutive failures per service at 3, respect Retry-After. No rotating identities/proxies.
